description: 국가철도공단_역사별 출구정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 또한 역사 출구정보는 도시 계획, 교통 안내 시스템 구축, 비상 대응 및 안전 관리, 대중교통 서비스 개선 등 다양한 분야에서 중요한 기초 자료로 활용되며, 철도 운영기관과 지역사회. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 역사별출구정보, 역사출구주변기관, 지하철출구, 출구위치정보, 인근시설정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
